description: Platform Bridge duplication budget baseline (ADR 0020). Lists allowed native-event and pacing exceptions while requiring neutral lifecycle and coordinate transformations to use moui/backend/platform_bridge.

allowlist.pattern: per-platform redraw frame loop (native present composition)
allowlist.reason: Wave 1 extracted all shared redraw state into WindowHostCoordinator (frame_pending, image repaint tracker, completion source, text input sync, runtime slot needs-redraw). What remains per platform is the final native present composition: window pre-present notify, decorations commands (Linux), platform-view draw setup and sync, and native handle access (NSView/X11/HWND). Loop skeleton is a candidate for full coordinator extraction in Wave 3.

allowlist.pattern: Texture native surface creation (mtl_texture, vulkan_image, egl_surface)
allowlist.reason: Each platform uses a different GPU API to create render-target textures. This is inherently platform-specific and cannot be abstracted.

allowlist.pattern: Discrete GPU enumeration and Metal/Vulkan/EGL device setup
allowlist.reason: Per-platform GPU backend selection (Metal device, Vulkan instance+device, EGL display) is inherently platform-specific.

rules: Platform backends MUST NOT reimplement make_surface_metrics or normalize_pointer_position — use platform_bridge versions.
Applicable window-hosted platform backends MUST import moui/backend/platform_bridge and use its transformers.
Platform-specific WindowEvent dispatch (pointer, keyboard, IME, drag) MUST remain in the platform backend — those carry platform-specific payloads that cannot be abstracted.

Render lifecycle helpers (drain prior present, resolve pending frame, record presented frame) belong in moui/runtime or moui/render, NOT platform_bridge — platform_bridge imports core + backend/host contracts only (ADR 0020).

Window host state (window requests, runtime slots, surfaces, image repaint, event sources, IME session) MUST live in moui/runtime WindowHostCoordinator; platform backends keep native decoding, window creation, and WindowSurfaceActions construction only.
Size conversions (host_metrics_to_dpi_size, core_size_to_window_surface_size) belong in @host, NOT in platform backends.
Platform backends MUST NOT define local window_event_to_host(_with_modifiers) forwarding shells — call @host directly.

moui/backend/wechat.reason: WeChat follows its Canvas2D lifecycle directly and must not fabricate a WindowEvent import. The validator still includes it in the capability inventory and rejects bridge-helper duplication.
